scope: Major audit controls, PG-01 through PG-18, Phase 0 through Phase 4 actions and exit criteria, hard autonomous-publishing gates and continuing prohibitions
supersedes: none - first machine-readable implementation matrix for the stabilisation audit
authority_scope: Traceability and local implementation classification only. It does not prove deployment, live-account state, production data integrity, elapsed evidence windows or permission to publish.

status_enum.implemented_local: The control has local source, test or documentation implementation. This does not prove deployment or a live outcome.
status_enum.evidence_only: Read-only evidence or a proposal exists, but the control is not fully implemented or its outcome is not established.
status_enum.external_gate: Completion requires verified state or an authorised change outside this local documentation lane.
status_enum.time_bound_gate: Completion requires an elapsed observation period, a real publication sample or both.
status_enum.intentionally_deferred: The item is deliberately not being activated in the current stabilisation phase.

classification_policy: A local implementation status never implies production deployment.
Where local code exists but the audit outcome depends on live evidence, the item is classified by the remaining external or time-bound gate.
Empty code_paths or test_paths are deliberate and must not be interpreted as missing JSON data.
Only paths present in this working tree at generation time are listed.
No item in this matrix grants permission to publish, mutate OAuth, alter tokens, change provider configuration or mutate a production database.
